item.title:
@kit27x Molten/Funtime Freddy are my second fav (they're tied) Freddies :D Kellen is so talented! 

The Rockstars are so fun, I wish there was more fan content with them these days but it's hard to blame anyone for ignoring them when their last full game appearance was UCN.
